summary: A beautifully upgraded two-bedroom semi-detached home, offering modern living and high-quality finishes. This home offers an attractive blend of modern upgrades, low-maintenance living, and outdoor space.

The entire property has been renovated, giving it a fresh and modern feel, perfect for move-in readiness. Integrated appliances add a sleek and seamless finish to the kitchen.The home is in pristine condition, reflecting careful attention to detail and high-quality workmanship throughout. Externally there is a driveway providing off-street parking, a highly convenient feature, side gated access to the low maintenance rear garden, the outdoor space is designed for easy upkeep, providing a relaxing environment without too much work. The garden shed is a standout feature, offering a fully equipped space with electricity, ideal for storage, a workshop, or even a home office. This outstanding property is ideal for families, with local schools and shops nearby for daily convenience and being a stones throw away from the nature reserve, perfect for outdoor enthusiasts, with easy access to natural spaces for walking, jogging, or relaxation. A real gem of a property which needs to be viewed to appreciate.
